Water bowls handover rules
The purpose of this section is to describe one way of working

At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk handles water bowls with the same care we give every traveling pet. A bowl must be clean, secure, and ready before it is passed from the desk to the ground team, and any concern about condition or fit must be raised at once. Safety takes priority over speed in every journey. When a carrier is moved, the bowl is checked for a stable position so it will not tip, spill, or impede the animal's movement.

The handover should be calm, clear, and documented in plain language. If a passenger appears worried, the senior coordinator should listen carefully, confirm the bowl arrangement, and explain what will happen next in reassuring terms. A bowl that has been used, cracked, or left loose must not travel with the carrier until it is replaced or secured. Staff should never guess about suitability; if there is any doubt, the matter is escalated before the pet is accepted for onward movement. The ground team moves carriers carefully between services. That handover includes a final visual check, a clean transfer of responsibility, and a brief confirmation that the bowl remains attached and visible.

If a traveler asks for help, the desk should respond with patience and respect, whether the pet is calm or restless. Careful attention at this stage helps prevent delays later and supports the welfare of the animal throughout the journey. Supervisors listen carefully when a passenger is worried. If uncertainty remains after the check, contact the shift supervisor or the duty manager at once for further guidance.
